response.why: Play Swamp (avg 53) is optimal. Leaves 0-2 (pass) show we fall further behind—opponent develops threats (flying Bats, Drowners) while we sit idle. Leaves 3-5 (Cast Preacher) score 50 average—we develop on-curve but remain vulnerable to removal and flying threats. Leaves 6-14 (Play Island) score 52 average with flexibility to cast flash Enduring Curiosity in response to opponent threats, but Island is weaker for Sheoldred later. Leaves 15-21 (Play Swamp) score 53 average—we ramp to {U}{U}{B}{B} or {U}{B}{B}{B}, enabling both Enduring Curiosity responses AND future Sheoldred (costs {2}{B}{B}). Leaves 15, 19-20 show opponent Cut Down/explore interactions that don't stop us; leaves 16-18 show we can respond with flash Enduring to their Preacher or develop independently. Swamp provides the most mana flexibility and best long-term setup.
response.plan: Play Swamp to ramp toward {B}{B}{B} available mana. Hold priority to respond with Enduring Curiosity (flash, 4/3 draw engine) if opponent deploys threats. Otherwise, pass to postcombat where we can cast Sheoldred next turn with ample mana. Win via creature threats, card advantage, and Sheoldred's draw tax.

response.why: Cast Sheoldred, the Apocalypse (avg 64) is decisively optimal. Leaves 0-8 (pass) score 43—we hold up mana to cast Enduring Curiosity reactively, but opponent threads multiple threats (Preacher, Kaito, flying Bats). Leaves 12-14 (Cast Preacher) score 51—we develop on-curve but Preacher enters tapped; opponent counters with stronger threats (Kaito planeswalker, Faerie draw engine). Leaves 15-17 (Cast Enduring) score 41—Enduring gets immediately destroyed by Go for the Throat (leaf 15) or faces overwhelming flying threats. Leaves 9-11 (Cast Sheoldred) score 64: Sheoldred is a 4/5 deathtouch finisher AND a draw tax engine. Leaf 9 shows Sheoldred's power—opponent casts Enduring, draws for it, triggering Sheoldred twice (we gain 4 life, they lose 4, ending at 16). Leaf 10 is exceptional: opponent tries Cut Down, but Sheoldred's mana value 4 is outside Cut Down's range (mana value 2 or less)—they waste removal and we resolve our threat. Leaf 11: despite flying threats, Sheoldred's 4/5 body and deathtouch dominates the board.
response.plan: Cast Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to establish both a powerful creature and a draw tax engine. Sheoldred punishes opponent draws (Enduring Curiosity, future plays) while rewarding our own draws, creating a damage race we're favored to win. Next combat turn, Sheoldred attacks and begins grinding toward victory via removal of opponent board and incremental damage from draw tax.

response.why: Opponent's only candidate is no-blocks, declining to use Preacher of the Schism as a blocker against our Sheoldred. This is the correct play for them—blocking would be disastrous: our Sheoldred (4/5 with deathtouch) kills their Preacher (any damage with deathtouch is lethal), their Preacher's 2 damage survives Sheoldred's deathtouch, resulting in a terrible trade where they lose a 2/4 creature for chip damage. By not blocking, they preserve their Preacher and take 2 damage instead of losing a creature (Sheoldred appears to deal 2 damage due to game interactions or prior state). Resulting position is favorable for us: Sheoldred dominates as a 4/5 deathtouch draw-tax engine (they lose 2 life whenever they draw, we gain 2 whenever we draw), while opponent has only small creatures (Spyglass Siren 1/1, untapped Preacher 2/4). We're at 19 life vs their 18, with Sheoldred online. This position strongly favors our grinding strategy toward inevitable victory.
response.plan: Next turn, we move to postcombat main and continue developing our board (cast Preacher of the Schism if we have mana) to create multiple threats. Sheoldred's draw tax accelerates our life total advantage and punishes opponent's draws. Grind the game toward victory through creature threats, card advantage engines, and incremental damage from Sheoldred's effect.

response.why: Pass (avg 51) vs Cast Enduring (avg 51) are nearly identical, but passing preserves flexibility and board strength. Leaves 0-8 (pass): We maintain Sheoldred on the battlefield—a 4/5 deathtouch legend with active draw tax that punishes all opponent draws. When we respond to threats with flash Enduring Curiosity (leaves 0-1, 3-4, 6-7), we convert their tempo play into our advantage. The three leaf-variants per threat (respond on stack, cast after, or hold) show escalating value: responding with flash gives us Enduring already threatening; casting after still gets the draw engine online; holding (leaf 2, 5, 8) keeps only Sheoldred but leaves us vulnerable to their multiple threats. Leaves 9-11 (cast Enduring now): Casting preemptively guarantees Enduring on board, but removes the ability to respond flexibly with flash. Leaf 9 (they play Sheoldred) creates a mutual draw-tax stalemate; leaf 10 (Cut Down) kills our Enduring but leaves us with Sheoldred (score 64 reflects Enduring's death but our remaining threat advantage); leaf 11 (Go for the Throat) is catastrophic—we lose Sheoldred (our best card) and only keep Enduring (score 36). Passing preserves Sheoldred while keeping Enduring as an instant-speed response tool, giving us better average positioning across all scenarios.
response.plan: Pass Upkeep and Draw. Maintain Sheoldred on the battlefield as the axis of our strategy. In Precombat Main, respond to opponent's threats with flash Enduring Curiosity if they develop creatures, or develop our own Preacher if they play removal. Win through Sheoldred's draw tax (opponent loses 2 life per draw, we gain 2 per draw), creature threats, and card advantage.
